mapper.sql: id, waiver_id, user_id, repayment_id, plan_id, waived_amount, penalty_snapshot, reason, status, applicant, approver, approve_remark, approved_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO penalty_waiver (waiver_id, user_id, repayment_id, plan_id, waived_amount, penalty_snapshot, reason, status, applicant) VALUES (#{waiverId}, #{userId}, #{repaymentId}, #{planId}, #{waivedAmount}, #{penaltySnapshot}, #{reason}, 'pending', #{applicant})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penalty_waiver WHERE repayment_id = #{repaymentId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE penalty_waiver SET status = 'approved', approver = #{approver}, approve_remark = #{remark}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE waiver_id = #{waiverId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE penalty_waiver SET status = 'rejected', approver = #{approver}, approve_remark = #{remark}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE waiver_id = #{waiverId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE penalty_waiver SET status = 'cancelled', approve_remark = #{remark}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE waiver_id = #{waiverId} AND status = 'pending' AND applicant = #{applicant}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM penalty_waiver
ORDER BY (status = 'pending') DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
